name: pandasdb-crm-comm
description: PandasDB CRM Communication System using AWS Lambda, Step Functions, and Supabase

scripts.deploy:custom: cross-env SERVICE_NAME=$npm_config_service dotenv npx serverless deploy --stage $npm_config_service && cross-env npm_config_service=$npm_config_service npm run upload-config:custom && cross-env npm_config_service=$npm_config_service npm run upload-knowledge:custom
scripts.deploy:dev: dotenv npx serverless deploy --stage dev && npm run upload-config:dev && npm run upload-knowledge:dev
scripts.deploy:prod: dotenv npx serverless deploy --stage prod && npm run upload-config:prod && npm run upload-knowledge:prod
scripts.upload-knowledge:dev: aws s3 cp knowledge/ s3://$(aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name pandasdb-crm-comm-dev --query 'Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey==`KnowledgeBaseBucket`].OutputValue' --output text)/knowledge/ --recursive
scripts.upload-knowledge:prod: aws s3 cp knowledge/ s3://$(aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name pandasdb-crm-comm-prod --query 'Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey==`KnowledgeBaseBucket`].OutputValue' --output text)/knowledge/ --recursive
scripts.upload-knowledge:custom: aws s3 cp knowledge/ s3://$(aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name $npm_config_service-$npm_config_service --query 'Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey==`KnowledgeBaseBucket`].OutputValue' --output text)/knowledge/ --recursive
scripts.upload-config:dev: aws s3 cp config/business.yml s3://$(aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name pandasdb-crm-comm-dev --query 'Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey==`KnowledgeBaseBucket`].OutputValue' --output text)/config/business.yml
scripts.upload-config:prod: aws s3 cp config/business.yml s3://$(aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name pandasdb-crm-comm-prod --query 'Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey==`KnowledgeBaseBucket`].OutputValue' --output text)/config/business.yml
scripts.upload-config:custom: aws s3 cp config/business.yml s3://$(aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name $npm_config_service-$npm_config_service --query 'Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey==`KnowledgeBaseBucket`].OutputValue' --output text)/config/business.yml
scripts.get-admin-token:custom: bash -c 'aws apigateway get-api-key --api-key $(aws apigateway get-api-keys --query "items[?name==\`$npm_config_service-dev-admin-api-key\`].id" --output text) --include-value --query value --output text'
scripts.get-admin-token:dev: aws apigateway get-api-key --api-key $(aws apigateway get-api-keys --query 'items[?name==`pandasdb-crm-comm-dev-admin-api-key`].id' --output text) --include-value --query 'value' --output text
scripts.get-admin-token:prod: aws apigateway get-api-key --api-key $(aws apigateway get-api-keys --query 'items[?name==`pandasdb-crm-comm-prod-admin-api-key`].id' --output text) --include-value --query 'value' --output text
